analysis: interim-1 sequential analysis (pilot, combined Phase A + Phase B)
deviation_note: Protocol 03 assumed an 8-cell pilot; executed pilot deferred F-T to Phase B for 2 preregistered families (claude+kimi). The tier x structure interaction is unestimable from Phase A alone, so the interim test uses combined A+B data (F-T = claude+kimi only).
bf_reliability_flag: BIC-approximated BFs for mixed models with variance components are indicative only; the combined-model BF01 is inconsistent with the balanced-subset rm-ANOVA and should not drive decisions.
analyst_recommendation: CONTINUE to main run: pre-registered analysis options disagree (LMM p=0.104 vs problem-level rm-ANOVA p=0.0018 on balanced subset); the significant interaction is OPPOSITE to H1's predicted direction and driven by claude alone (claude p=0.0004, kimi p=0.23). The main run with all 8 cells x 5 families resolves existence and direction.
